SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
SP. BR. REGISTRY
No. N. 1479
Date 13/ 6 / 42

Foreign Affairs S.B. Station. File No. Date June 13, 1942.

經
報

SUBJECT: Departure to Peking of Mr.P.Dufour, director
of the Havas Agency in the Far East.

Mr.P.Dufour, director of the Havas News Agency
in the Far East, departed yesterday evening for Peking in
a buisness trip. He is expected to stay there for about
2 weeks.

V.Semenoff
C.A.
Officer i/c.Foreign Affairs S.B.

事由：哈瓦斯通讯社远东区主任 P. Dufour 先生前往北平。
哈瓦斯新闻社（Havas News Agency）远东区主任 P. Dufour 先生于昨晚启程前往北平进行公务旅行。预计他将在那里停留约两周。
